Monsoon Rains Vary Across India, With Deficits and Records

Several Indian states are experiencing varied monsoon patterns. Karnataka has a 29% deficit in rainfall, though early August saw a 39% surplus. Delhi recorded its wettest August day in two years, surpassing its monthly average rainfall within the first eight days. Meanwhile, 14 states are on alert for heavy rain and thunderstorms, with warnings issued for specific districts in Kerala and Tamil Nadu. In contrast, Uttar Pradesh's monsoon is described as weak, with increased humidity expected in some areas and light rain in others.
